answer_1.quote: Stylized Visual Storytelling (SVST) aims to generate a stylized story to describe a sequence of images (5 images in our following experiments).

answer_2.quote: We evaluate our results from three aspects: semantic relevance, style accuracy, and fluency.

answer_4.quote: We also conduct human evaluations using three metrics: (1) Relevance that measures relationship between the generated stories and the source photo stream. (2) Style appropriateness which means how well the stories express the target style. (3) Coherence that measures the inter-sentence coherency of the whole story.
answer_4.guideline: Relevance is rated from 0 (unrelated) to 3 (very related), coherence from 0 (unreadable) to 3 (perfect), and style appropriateness from 0 (bad) to 3 (perfect).
